description: This file defines a PHP class 'Repair' inside the namespace 'Step\Acceptance'. It extends the 'Administration' class and provides a method to automate the 'Quick Repair and Rebuild' process within a SuiteCRM testing framework. The method interacts with the web UI by clicking buttons and waiting for specific text.

classes.name: Repair
classes.description: A class representing the repair step in acceptance tests, automating the quick repair and rebuild process in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: clickQuickRepairAndRebuild
methods.description: Automates the process of navigating to the admin page, clicking the repair button, and selecting 'Quick Repair and Rebuild' in the SuiteCRM admin interface.
